submissions.title: New Texas data center projects frozen until state audits them
submissions.excerpt: New Texas data center projects frozen until state audits them
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Gov. Greg Abbott directed the Public Utility Commission of Texas and ERCOT on Aug 3, 2026 to audit every data center project in the ERCOT interconnection queue before it may proceed; ERCOT has paused its 'Batch Zero' review as a result. Multiple secondary outlets (Utility Dive headline: 'Facing an estimated 474 GW of interconnection requests, Texas hits pause on data centers'; K&L Gates client alert dated 8/4/26) put the paused queue at roughly 474 GW of requests, ~90% attributed to data centers -- this 474 GW figure could not be independently confirmed against primary-source text this session because direct fetch of external article bodies (WebFetch/curl) was blocked by this session's network egress policy; treat as LOW confidence pending human verification. This is a statewide, not project-specific, restriction. Many tracked Texas UNDER_CONSTRUCTION/ANNOUNCED projects sit in the ERCOT interconnection queue and could be affected, e.g. Cipher Black Pearl, IREN Childress, IREN Sweetwater, Meta El Paso, Aligned Project Caprock, Fluidstack Abernathy, Crusoe Goodnight, Abilene Clean Campus (Crusoe), Stargate Milam County, Stargate Shackelford County, CyrusOne Freestone, Microsoft Pecos, Nscale Barstow, QTS-Lancium Hall County. Not attaching to any single project -- a human should determine per-project applicability based on each project's interconnection queue status.

claims.methodology: Secondary press reports (Utility Dive, K&L Gates) state ERCOT's paused interconnection queue totals approximately 474 GW (~90% data centers); this is a statewide queue-wide backlog figure, not a single-project capacity figure, and was not independently verified against a primary ERCOT/PUC document this session.

Flagging as a new local moratorium action for the siting-restrictions dataset; not linked to an existing project.
